injuries.summary:
**Today’s NFL injury briefing**

**Biggest developments**
- **Cardinals:** P **Blake Gillikin** hurt his groin in warm-ups, was shut down for the day, and will get an MRI Sunday. S **Dadrion Taylor-Demerson** has a ribs injury that Mike LaFleur doesn’t think is serious, but his status isn’t firm yet. WR **Xavier Weaver** (hamstring), CB **Kei’Trel Clark** (hip), and S **Wydett Williams Jr.** / CB **Kalen King** (concussion evaluations) are also newly listed.
  - **Why it matters:** Arizona’s depth in the secondary and on special teams got hit in one game.

- **Cowboys/Cardinals:** S **Julius Wood** left the Cardinals game in concussion protocol and was ruled out.
  - **Why it matters:** Another depth loss in the back end.

- **Chiefs:** **Tyreke Smith** was ruled out with a hamstring injury.
  - **Why it matters:** New missed-time concern for Kansas City.

- **Nephi Sewell:** He was carted off with a **leg/knee injury**; one report says he had been in concussion protocol last week. Severity wasn’t specified.
  - **Why it matters:** This is the injury to watch most closely for seriousness.

- **49ers:** Good news on the return front. RB **Jordan James** is back from a broken rib. **Dominick Puni** and **CJ West** were also back in practice. On the other side, **De’Zhaun Stribling** and **Deommodore Lenoir** are day-to-day with shoulder issues. **Austen Pleasants** (knee) did not practice, and **Renardo Green** (hamstring), **Nick Martin** (hamstring), and **Robert Jones** (calf) were out.
  - **Why it matters:** San Francisco’s RB and interior depth looks better, but multiple injury spots remain in the secondary and trenches.

- **Seahawks:** WR **Jake Bobo** was placed on season-ending IR with a serious knee injury. WR **Julian Hicks** was re-signed.
  - **Why it matters:** Bobo is done for the year, so Seattle’s WR depth chart changes.

**What to watch next**
- Gillikin’s MRI
- Final word on Taylor-Demerson and Sewell
- Whether Stribling, Lenoir, and the 49ers’ other day-to-day players can get back on the field
